input.definition: A collection where the most recently added item is removed first.
A collection where the earliest added item is removed first.
Transforms readable data into unreadable ciphertext using a key.
Transforms unreadable ciphertext back into readable data using a key.
Encodes data using fewer bytes to reduce storage size.
Restores data from a compressed representation to its original form.
Verifies the identity of a user trying to access a system.
Determines which resources a verified user is permitted to access.
